citations.narrative:
No communication has been made by the registrant to USDA APHIS Animal Care to let the agency know of a mailing
address change. Failure to provide change of current address prevents Animal Care from inspecting and communicating
on adequate animal care and welfare. A registrant shall notify the Deputy Administrator by certified mail or email of any
change in the name, address, or ownership, or other change in operations affecting its status as an exhibitor, carrier, or
intermediate handler, within 10 days after making such change.
To be corrected by: 4-September-2026

citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 9:31 AM on
8/19/2026. The inspectors attempted to contact the registrant by honking the vehicle horn and called the phone number
on file. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and
regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
Additional Inspectors:
Makayla Willis, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICEREnd Section
